g.text: GIVE · SPONSOR · BE PART OF IT
One day, hundreds of families through the gates — games, food and films —
funding scholarships, medical help and an emergency fund, all year
No names, no fuss — money that reached people who needed it, last year.
Every rupee we raise this year, after event costs, is split three ways — announced
up front, tracked on a public ledger anyone can check.
School fees, books and exam costs
gives a week of groceries for a family having a hard month
gives exam fees and a set of textbooks for one student
gives a real dent in a hospital bill a family can't meet alone
SPONSOR OR DONATE — TALK TO US
